notes.title: Steam Release and Thanks
notes.notes:
I want to say a big thank to everyone! I appreciated all the great feedback and didn't expect the game to generate this much interest. It's also funny seeing all the puns (I didn't even consider that when picking the title).



The game launches on Steam tomorrow. It’s not a very long game compared to others, but there's a good amount of fun things to do and discover. For those who enjoy optimizing, there’s a "View Stats" in the options to help find the best strategy.



Hope you'll enjoy the game!

notes.title: Trash in the hole - Version 0.17
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

- Fixed bugs
- Small rebalancing
- Made a few quality-of-life improvements
- Added more options in the settings

New Feature:

You can now see the garbage inside the hole. If it doesn't appear, check your settings to enable it. There may be a conflict with old save files. Hopefully this new feature doesn't not slow down the game.

notes.title: Version 0.05
notes.notes:
For those interested in the development. In version 0.05, I changed a lot of little things. The main buildings are almost working how I wanted.

The next update will focus more on upgrades (research, store, ...).

I'll release a demo on Steam when the game is closer to what I have in mind.
